title: USS Gerald R. Ford (CVN 78) Full Ship Shock Trials
description: The aircraft carrier USS Gerald R. Ford (CVN 78) successfully completed the third and final scheduled explosive event of Full Ship Shock Trials while underway in the Atlantic Ocean, Aug. 8, 2021. The U.S. Navy conducts shock trials of new ship designs using live explosives to confirm that our warships can continue to meet demanding mission requirements under harsh conditions they might encounter in battle. (U.S. Navy video by Mass Communication Specialist 3rd Class Novalee Manzella)
